notes: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH documentation previews with source-derived hue/chroma, not normative source colors.
App content is bounded to 440 logical units; navigation becomes a 96-unit side rail at 768 logical units.
Shared CareUI sections and tracking groups start 32 logical units apart; Home section headings use 32 above and 16 below, with nested water headings exempt.
Setup has three required profile steps followed by optional reminders in a four-segment indicator. Explicit notification permission, skipping and denial preserve completion.
HTML hover/focus states are documentation affordances; production native pressed and accessibility states remain authoritative.

Native initial splash is configured separately in app.json using expo-splash-screen, background #FFFDFA, existing assets/android-icon-foreground.png and imageWidth 192. One branded JavaScript surface follows it, without a timed second screen. Development-build startup evidence does not establish standalone launch validation.
Shared signed-in header keeps menu left, centered brand and notification bell right. Detail back/title controls occupy a second row. Home uses the same header; the profile shortcut is removed.

Sidebar uses a same-window Expo BlurTargetView, blur intensity 45 and dark dim layer. Main content is touch- and accessibility-hidden while open. Open/close animations use 200ms/160ms, or zero duration with reduced motion.

Profile uses an 88-unit avatar, one Edit profile action, a wrapping weight/height/BMI strip and flat grouped account controls. Delete account leads to an explicit unchecked acknowledgement before the destructive action enables.

Today's activity uses the connected source when available, otherwise entered totals or supported foreground phone steps; sources are not added together. Explicit Activity source navigation is honored. Home omits the duplicate seven-day steps plot.
City setup uses optional foreground permission and reverse geocoding with manual fallback. Only the city enters profile payloads; no coordinate upload or ongoing location tracking is implemented.

The on-device, account-scoped notification inbox retains up to 120 past reminders within 90 days plus 60 pending reminders, with monotonic read status. Due scheduled reminders do not establish delivery or completion.

October 29 extension preserves all existing token primitives and the Growing Well world. Synthetic React Native Web final previews support layout review only; Android blur, native permission prompts, large text and physical-device behavior remain unverified. See docs/profile-navigation-revamp.md.

narrative.overview: Cream white, forest-green actions and a restrained plum accent make everyday care feel approachable. Health management and daily wellness carry equal weight. Quiet grouped rows and progressive disclosure support one clear task at a time.
keyCharacteristics: Cream-white canvas and flat tonal surfaces.
Forest-green actions, dark green ink and restrained plum status accents.
Crisp sans typography, grouped lists and modestly rounded controls.
Original Arogio logo; code-led composition without new shipping raster artwork.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Use forest green for available primary actions and retain explicit text for unavailable services.

rules.name: The One Task Rule
rules.body: Group related information behind clear rows or disclosures; retain one personal Edit profile action and a separate Goals & preferences destination.

dos: Do preserve the Arogio name and original logo proportions.
Do reuse shared tokens, keyboard scrolling, font scaling and accessible control targets.
Do distinguish available actions from services labeled Coming soon.
donts: Don't return to decorative tile walls or repeated edit controls.
Don't treat documentation previews as native rendered verification.
Don't imply reminders, records or daily tracking are available before implementation.
